eps.t: Strawberry Shortcake in Big Apple City
eps.d: Strawberry Shortcake travels to Big Apple City to compete with the Peculiar Purple Pieman of Porcupine Peak in a televised bakeoff.
Strawberry Shortcake and her cat Custard are hosting and judging a pet show, but the Purple Pieman and Sour Grapes plotting to have their pets win by cheating.
Strawberry Shortcake goes on a camping trip with her friends including her newest friend, Baby Needs A Name who finds a new friend in the forest.

Strawberry Shortcake and her friends meet the Berry Princess and her Berrykins who give the berries and other fruits their smells, but Peculiar Purple Pieman's cloud machine is giving them the wrong smells.
